speaker: ORB
text: Helmets off.

speaker: ORB
text: These two used to be a band. Four years. One bus. One stage.

speaker: ORB
text: She went solo. He's still angry about it.

speaker: ORB
text: If they survive thirty days on this planet — together — they go home with what's in that crate.

speaker: ORB
text: When did the band end?

speaker: PIP
text: Three years ago.

speaker: GRUFF
text: She quit. Mid-tour.

speaker: ORB
text: Still sore.

speaker: ORB
text: Nobody's making you. But the second those anklets lock, the thirty days are running.

speaker: GRUFF
text: Running.

speaker: ORB
text: Both locked.

speaker: ORB
text: Cross this line and you quit. If either of you quits, I take you both home tonight — and the crate goes home with me.

speaker: ORB
text: Have fun down there.

speaker: ORB
text: One thousand metres across. Its own sky, if you squint. Her camp is at the north pole.

speaker: ORB
text: His cave is at the south. On a planet this size they can go a week without seeing each other. Which is roughly the plan.

speaker: ORB
text: That's THE COUNT. It keeps the number. The number is the only thing on this planet that changes.

speaker: ORB
text: Facilities.

speaker: ORB
text: And on the equator: the crate. Nobody opens it before Day 20. Not even me.

speaker: PIP
text: You don't know what's in it?

speaker: ORB
text: I know exactly what's in it.

speaker: PIP
text: Sooner or later one of us has to bring it up. I'm hoping it's later.

speaker: GRUFF
text: I've been cold to her. I'm allowed. She left.

speaker: ORB
text: They think this is about surviving. It isn't.

speaker: ORB
text: Here's the engine. Every deal I offer them shrinks this planet.

speaker: ORB
text: Right now they can avoid each other. At a hundred metres they'll hear each other breathe. At two, there's nowhere to stand but together.

speaker: ORB
text: So. Does a smaller world bring them back — or finish them off?

speaker: ORB
text: Day five. First offer. Under the left lid: nothing changes. You keep your thousand-metre planet.

speaker: ORB
text: Under the right lid: I halve it. Five hundred metres. And I add a hundred thousand to whatever is in the crate.

speaker: GRUFF
text: Money's money.

speaker: PIP
text: We haven't seen each other in four days. We could live at five hundred.

speaker: GRUFF
text: We could live at fifty.

speaker: PIP
text: Halve it.

speaker: ORB
text: Their first camp was on that piece.

speaker: GRUFF
text: Huh.

speaker: ORB
text: Less than a day at half size, and it's already going wrong. Gravity now drags both camps into the same valley.

speaker: ORB
text: His snoring carries. All the way round.

speaker: PIP
text: Nope. Nope nope nope.

speaker: PIP
text: I'd rather be chained to a stranger. A stranger would at least talk to me.

speaker: PIP
text: Six days. You've said nine words.

speaker: GRUFF
text: You'd rather be anywhere I'm not. That's the whole story. It's always been the whole story.

speaker: PIP
text: You wrote one song in four years! One! And it was about your van!

speaker: ORB
text: Nobody wins this one.

speaker: PIP
text: Clean slate?

speaker: GRUFF
text: …Fine.

speaker: ORB
text: Day ten. Today's shrink is on the house. No deal, no money, no choice.

speaker: ORB
text: Gift: THE COUNT gets thrusters. It can fetch things now. Try not to break it.

speaker: ORB
text: And from here on, the money gets serious. So will the planet.

speaker: ORB
text: He didn't mention it. She noticed he kept it.

speaker: ORB
text: So what actually broke the band?

speaker: PIP
text: I sat in the dressing room every night thinking nobody in that band would notice if I vanished. So I vanished first.

speaker: GRUFF
text: I noticed.

speaker: GRUFF
text: I just never said it out loud.

speaker: PIP
text: So what do we do now?

speaker: GRUFF
text: I haven't seen further than thirty metres in two weeks.

speaker: GRUFF
text: I'm not doing great. In the head.

speaker: ORB
text: Real air. Real trees. Real shade. All of it is yours — if the planet goes to a hundred metres.

speaker: PIP
text: …No.

speaker: ORB
text: Ten seconds to change your mind.

speaker: GRUFF
text: There were trees.

speaker: ORB
text: Regret it yet?

speaker: ORB
text: Remember — there's still a crate.

speaker: PIP
text: Bandmates?

speaker: GRUFF
text: Bandmates.

speaker: ORB
text: He's on chapter three.

speaker: PIP
text: You still wear that thing?

speaker: GRUFF
text: There's something about it I'll tell you.

speaker: GRUFF
text: The last night on this rock. Not before.

speaker: ORB
text: Day twenty. Five platters. One of them opens the crate. Careful — the best deal might be the one you skip.

speaker: ORB
text: Pay two hundred thousand out of the prize.

speaker: GRUFF
text: No.

speaker: ORB
text: Five hundred thousand.

speaker: GRUFF
text: No.

speaker: ORB
text: Shrink the planet to twenty-five metres.

speaker: GRUFF
text: Take it.

speaker: PIP
text: Take it.

speaker: ORB
text: Free. It was free.

speaker: ORB
text: Two tickets on the rescue ship. You both go home. Whoever wins, whoever doesn't.

speaker: GRUFF
text: That's the redemption. Right there.

speaker: ORB
text: The tickets come at a cost. Look down.

speaker: ORB
text: Twenty-five metres. They cannot be out of arm's reach. Sleeping, washing, the toilet — everything within three metres.

speaker: PIP
text: It can't get smaller than this.

speaker: ORB
text: It can.

speaker: ORB
text: I'm changing the rules of this entire video.

speaker: ORB
text: The escape pod launch key. The pod has one seat. Whoever launches it goes home now — with the whole prize. The other one gets nothing.

speaker: ORB
text: And from today the planet loses size every single day. Twenty. Twelve. Seven. Four. Two.

speaker: ORB
text: This is the part I like. Green for truth. Red for a lie. Ask each other anything.

speaker: GRUFF
text: Were you better off solo?

speaker: PIP
text: No.

speaker: PIP
text: Would you launch the pod?

speaker: GRUFF
text: I'd never leave you on a rock.

speaker: ORB
text: Unverified. Technical fault. Moving on.

speaker: GRUFF
text: Same question.

speaker: PIP
text: No.

speaker: GRUFF
text: She got her happy ending on camera.

speaker: GRUFF
text: I could take the whole prize and be gone before she wakes up. Nobody would even blame me.

speaker: PIP
text: Maybe he wants it to be even. Maybe after what I did, that's fair.

speaker: ORB
text: You're not planning to launch alone, are you?

speaker: GRUFF
text: …Good question.

speaker: PIP
text: Put me down.

speaker: GRUFF
text: Where?

speaker: GRUFF
text: Every bump makes me want to hit that lever.

speaker: PIP
text: I think he's getting ready to leave.

speaker: GRUFF
text: I sold the tour van.

speaker: GRUFF
text: I was buying you a solo ticket. Real one. Real label. Your name on it. I was going to give it to you on stage.

speaker: GRUFF
text: You left the week before.

speaker: PIP
text: That's why you kept it.

speaker: GRUFF
text: That's why I kept it.

speaker: PIP
text: I'm scared of the next twenty-four hours.

speaker: GRUFF
text: The whole prize would change my life more than half of it.

speaker: GRUFF
text: And after this we might never talk again anyway.

speaker: ORB
text: Ten minutes.

speaker: ORB
text: A minute and twelve seconds. Last chance to launch.

speaker: ORB
text: Sixteen seconds.

speaker: ORB
text: Three.

speaker: ORB
text: Two.

speaker: ORB
text: One.

speaker: ORB
text: Time's up.

speaker: ORB
text: Half each. And both tickets.

speaker: ORB
text: So — what's next for the two of you?

text: Band's back. Subscribe.
